{{Quote|It was the Commission for the Protection of the Republic, strutting little twerps who wanted firm government as long as it was imposed on lesser beings and not them.|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ordo Skirata|Null-11]]|<ref name="Order 66 novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
The '''Commission for the Protection of the Republic''' ('''COMPOR''') was established during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as a political movement of patriotic citizens of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its members were fiercely loyal to the Republic government's [[Head of State/Legends|head of state]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and often lobbied for constitutional amendments that invested greater power within the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|executive branch]]. When the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], with Palpatine as its self-appointed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|emperor]], COMPOR was reorganized into the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] (COMPNOR).

==History==
{{Quote|This is sensationalist nonsense. These echelons that gathered today mark the first generation of the SAGroup brigadiers. We cannot help that the first to join happened to be of human descent. We have non-human applicants, to be sure. Their applications are still under review.|Crueya Vandron, addressing concerns about COMPOR's Human-dominated membership to the media|<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:9:04">{{InsiderCite|70|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:9:04}}</ref>}}
[[File:70RepublicYouthSpeechFinal.jpg|thumb|left|250px|COMPOR's SAGroup holds a patriotic youth rally on Coruscant to galvanize support for the Galactic Republic.]]
The Commission for the Protection of the Republic (COMPOR) was a political organization created and sponsored by the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Designed to promote loyalty and patriotism within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], COMPOR's primary function was to brainstorm ideas and reforms that could be implemented in order to ensure the continuation of the Republic amidst the chaos of a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] divided by war. The vast majority of its suggestions included, in some form or another, strengthening the power of the executive branch at the expense of the other parts of government.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> The committee's subdivisions included the [[SAGroup (COMPOR)/Legends|Sub-Adult Group]] (SAGroup), a youth organization composed of adolescent citizens who strongly supported the Republic and its [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Commander-in-Chief]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Insider 70" />

COMPOR also lobbied for the deportation of certain [[Species/Legends|beings]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], particularly those whose [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] supported the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebellion]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In order to achieve its objectives, the committee sought to encourage government officials to comply with COMPOR's demands, even to the point of resorting to coercive tactics. One such official who was compelled to support COMPOR was [[First Minister (Coruscant Ministry of Ingress)/Legends|First Minister]] [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]] of the [[Coruscant Ministry of Ingress/Legends|Coruscant Ministry of Ingress]]. At COMPOR's insistence, Praji deported various alien species from Coruscant, such as the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]].<ref name="db">{{DB|character|tannonpraji|Praji, Tannon}}</ref>

Near the end of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], many COMPOR members were commissioned as [[Republic officer/Legends|officers]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Luszgoti]], an officer with ties to COMPOR, had a confrontation with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ordo Skirata|Null-11]], a [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Null''-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]], aboard the naval [[Republic Fleet Auxiliary Support Vessel|support ship]] [[Redeemer (Republic Fleet Auxiliary Support Vessel)|''Redeemer'']]. Luszgoti asserted that [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and recruited [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] did not outrank official members of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], such as enlisted personnel and commissioned officers.<ref name="Order 66 novel" />

When the Clone Wars was concluded with the decisive defeat of the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the [[Order 66/Legends|near annihilation]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Chancellor Palpatine issued the [[Declaration of a New Order]] during a [[Special session of Congress/Legends|special session]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on Coruscant. In his speech, Palpatine decreed that the Republic was to become the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], ruled by himself as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|emperor]]. COMPOR enthusiastically supported the new absolute monarch and his move to finalize the end of the Republic and its democratic system. Mere days after the birth of Emperor Palpatine's [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], COMPOR merged itself with the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], an offshoot of the newly formed [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], to create the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] (COMPNOR). [[Crueya Vandron/Legends|Crueya Vandron]] and [[Ishin-Il-Raz]], two of COMPOR's earliest members, became leading figures in COMPNOR during the reign of Emperor Palpatine.<ref name="Insider 84" />
